literal_meaning: অষ্ট পাশে বা দিকে (eight sides or directions)
figurative_meaning_en: All over the body; from all sides
similar_in_english: Up to one's neck in troubles
example_sentences_in_english: I'm caught in the web of worldly affairs from all sides.
Debts have surrounded me on all sides.
history: Derived from Sanskrit term referring to the eight directions (অষ্ট দিক), symbolizing complete encirclement, commonly used in classical Bengali literature.
note: Variant spelling 'আষ্টেপৃষ্ঠে' is a phonetic alternative.
